name: No-Sugar-Added Lemon Berry Cheesecake
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Cruise Line · Main Dining Rooms
whyItWorks: Whipped cheesecake mousse has a smooth, zero-roughage texture, but lemon citrus, berry seeds, and sugar alcohols in "no-sugar-added" desserts make it a careful/good-day pick.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip if you follow a strict citrus guardrail or if sugar alcohols (maltitol/sorbitol) trigger osmotic urgency. Otherwise, scrape off any whole berry garnish with seeds and enjoy the smooth filling.
flareEmergencySwap: Order plain vanilla ice cream / Mickey Premium Ice Cream Bar or warm Crème Brûlée (without berries) instead.
watchOuts: Sugar alcohols / artificial sweeteners in no-sugar-added desserts
